mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which can signal broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 12-month MA and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL rising, but SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling, but SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS > 12-month MA and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below its 6-month moving average signals a contraction in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 < 6-month MA and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
